subject: Renewal: Term alignment & uptake acceleration for SaaSify Inc.
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@saasify.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@saasify.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: Term alignment & uptake acceleration for SaaSify Inc.

Hi Sara / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our call, I put together a short proposal to align SaaSify's renewal term to your fiscal cadence and to create a simple uptake path that reduces operational risk while unlocking better unit economics as you ramp. Attached is a clean term sheet (SaaSify_TermSheet_v2.pdf) and a one-page pricing view (redwood_quick_pricing.xlsx).

High level proposal (summary):
- Term: 36 months with an optional 12-month early-exit step for business continuity.
- Credits: $75k one-time onboarding credit applied against the first 90 days of usage to cover migration/onboarding.
- Ramp: Commit starts at 50% of year-1 projected tokens, steps up by fixed buckets each quarter (see sheet).
- Canary: 6-week phased migration window with automatic fallback to hosted endpoints and a 10% throughput buffer.
- Billing: Quarterly invoice; true-up at each anniversary date.

Open items we flagged for your team: amortization of the onboarding credit across accounting, whether two satellite teams (Marketing & Analytics) should be folded into the same term, and whether you want us to frontload extra support during the first 30 days.

Next steps: if this looks directionally correct, we can:
1) Lock the term and credit mechanics in a draft amendment and send for DocuSign.
2) Stand up a canary plan with our Solutions Engineer (suggested dates: Mar 15–Apr 30).

I copied procurement since they asked for a formal term sheet. Happy to jump on a follow-up call this week.

Best,

Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183

Attachments: SaaSify_TermSheet_v2.pdf (term sheet, 3 pages); redwood_quick_pricing.xlsx (pricing summary)
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@saasify.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@saasify.com
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: Term alignment & uptake acceleration for SaaSify Inc.

Thanks Olga — this is helpful and closer to what Finance wants to see. A few clarifying questions before we circulate internally:

1) Accounting: Can the $75k onboarding credit be amortized over 24 months instead of booked against the first quarter? That helps our forecasting.
2) Scope: We do want Marketing and Analytics to be under the same program, but they operate on different consumption profiles. Is it possible to create two sub-bands under the same master term so we don't have to manage separate contracts?
3) Canary: The canary window is good, but procurement asked for an explicit SLO trigger that will revert the canary if token latency or error rate exceeds threshold X for more than 48 hours. Can you include the fallback steps?

Also — we'll need the DocuSign-ready amendment and a short summary line itemizing the financial impact (year 1 vs year 2). Procurement asked that we get a signature by EoM to avoid a mid-quarter billing gap.

If you can tweak the term sheet and return it, I'll start the internal approval route.

—Sara
Sara Jenkins
Director, Cloud Platform
SaaSify Inc.
sara.jenkins@saasify.com | +1 617-555-0139

Subject: Fwd: Renewal: Term alignment & uptake acceleration for SaaSify Inc. — recommended concession and canary wording

Team — forwarding Sara's questions. Quick recommended posture below so we can move to DocuSign this week:

Summary recommendation (internal):
- Amortization: Offer to amortize the $75k onboarding credit over 24 months for accounting friendliness. Language: "Customer may amortize onboarding credit equally over 24 months for reporting purposes; invoicing will apply credit in month 1."
- Sub-bands: Create a single master amendment with two consumption buckets (Marketing / Analytics) each with its own volume bands but a shared annual commitment. Keeps legal tidy, ops aligned.
- Canary SLO: Define trigger as >5% 95th percentile latency increase OR >1.5% errors sustained for 48 hours. If triggered, auto-fallback to hosted endpoint + immediate rollback plan; we own remediation window of 72 hours.
- Pricing tweak: Add an incremental volume band at 1.5x projected usage with a blended rate to incentivize overage scaling (details in attached pricing sheet).

I attached a quick pricing view with the amortization numbers pulled through (redwood_quick_pricing.xlsx). If Marissa and Karthik approve, Priyom can bake the language into the amendment and I will send back to Sara with DocuSign link.

Notes for approval: this keeps total economic impact within the board-approved discount band; net present value improves long-term while giving SaaSify operational comfort for the initial ramp.

Olga
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference

- Sub-bands: Draft amendment now contains two consumption buckets under a single master term; each bucket has separate volume bands and true-up rules (see attached term sheet).
- Canary SLOs: Canary will revert automatically if >5% 95th pctl latency increase OR error rate >1.5% sustained for 48 hours; we commit a 72-hour remediation window.
- Pricing: Added 1.5x overage blended band to reduce friction on initial spikes (financial impact table attached).
